settings.heading: Every pet is a muse
settings.text: PawsPal is a small art studio that happens to be a shop. Everything here starts as an illustration — drawn by hand, coloured like a paintbox, and made for the animals who run our homes and our hearts. Nothing is mass-produced, because nothing about your pet is.
